title: The Episode About Shamas Khan and Baizid Khan

blocks.text: A sharp engagement follows in which hidden Singhs regroup and strike back after a moment of uncertainty, turning what looked like flight into renewed coordinated resistance.
The Turks begin to feel death closing around them even before the battlefield settles, because the Sikh return from concealment unravels their confidence.
The phrase hidden Singhs captures the tactical character of the page: concealed endurance suddenly becoming violent reappearance.
